events.name_en: Vehicle breakdown with equipment (and a patient) on board
events.name_sl: Okvara vozila z opremo (in pacientom) na krovu

engine_event.note: engine failure, defibrillator set and patient on board

expected_replan: A07 out of service; its queued trips are reassigned
The patient aboard is picked up first, at the breakdown site, as urgent
EQ-002 is collected from the breakdown site by another vehicle BEFORE it is delivered to zd_ig (challenge rule)
Ambulances are kept free for emergencies; sanitary vans take the seated and wheelchair cases
A replacement vehicle is due within 2 hours at most (dispatch rulebook, art. 22); a reserve vehicle needs a crew
messages_sl: Vozilo je obstalo. Oprema je še v njem.
A07 ima okvaro motorja na Zaloški cesti, pacient je še v vozilu.
Zmanjkalo nam je goriva, stojimo v Medvodah.
basis: challenge brief: equipment in a broken vehicle must first be picked up by another vehicle

expected_replan: Trips later in A03's queue that now miss due_by move to other vehicles when that helps
messages_sl: Zaradi kolone zamujamo približno petindvajset minut.
Stojimo za zaledenelim tovornjakom, še dvajset minut.
basis: challenge brief: vehicle delays

engine_event.description: Zaloška cesta closed after a collision (near UKC)

expected_replan: Legs that pass the closure are re-timed; trips to and from UKC from the east are re-routed or swapped
messages_sl: Zaloška cesta je zaprta zaradi nesreče pri UKC.
Cesta proti Vrhniki je zaprta, ne moremo mimo.
basis: challenge brief: road closures
same closure as the team's stroke scenario

events.name_sl: Nova nujna naloga: sum na možgansko kap
expected_replan: Nearest suitable free NRV is sent, even if it must leave a lower-priority trip
Hospital pre-alert is drafted
messages_sl: Nujno! Sum na možgansko kap v Polju, pacient je na nosilih.
Klic: padec na ledu v Šiški, sum na zlom kolka.
basis: challenge brief: urgent new task

events.name_en: Second urgent call while teams are busy
events.name_sl: Drugi nujni klic, ekipe so zasedene

engine_event.note: chest pain, second emergency within 10 minutes

expected_replan: Both emergencies are served; the dispatcher keeps an even access time across the area
messages_sl: Še en nujen klic: bolečina v prsih v Črnučah.
basis: UKC dispatch plan: spread teams so access time is even

expected_replan: All legs slow down; late trips are reprioritised
messages_sl: Sneži, ceste so spolzke, vozimo počasneje.
basis: team's snow scenario

events.name_en: Fog grounds the helicopter for 1 hour
expected_replan: H1 cannot take any task until 09:30; tasks planned for H1 move to road vehicles
If the organ task is waiting, it switches to an ambulance if the deadline still holds
messages_sl: Megla na Brniku, helikopter ne more vzleteti vsaj eno uro.
HNMP je zaradi megle prizemljen.
basis: challenge brief: fog grounds the helicopter for 1 h at the centre
HNMP site: fog on a fifth to a quarter of days at Brnik

expected_replan: The trip's due_by tightens to the emergency slack; a nearer vehicle is chosen
messages_sl: Pacient P-127 se je poslabšal, zdaj je nujno.
basis: challenge brief: patient priority change

events.name_en: Reduced hospital capacity: yellow alarm at UKC
events.name_sl: Zmanjšana kapaciteta bolnišnice: rumeni alarm v UKC
expected_replan: Non-urgent arrivals at UKC are delayed or moved to the outpatient clinics where possible
Red cases still go to UKC (no alternative in the region); a distribution key limits how many arrive per hour
Planner reads forecasts at +1 h and +2 h
messages_sl: UKC je razglasil rumeni alarm. Prostih je le še en reanimacijski prostor.
Urgenca je polna, sprejemamo samo življenjsko ogrožene.
basis: MCI guideline: green, yellow, red hospital alarm; free capacity reported within 15 min with +1 h and +2 h forecasts
UKC is the only large emergency hospital in the Ljubljana region

expected_replan: Nearest NRVs go first, one per red patient; the rest follow by triage
Cancel or delay scheduled trips; recall busy teams as soon as they finish
Free reserve vehicles are staffed by recalls (lead time assumed)
Helicopter used only if daylight and no fog; one patient per flight
Hospital distribution key applied

vehicle_estimate.capacity_rule: an emergency ambulance is equipped for about 2 serious + 2 lighter patients
vehicle_estimate.practical_inference: 1 per red + 1 per 2 yellow + 1 per 4 green = 3 + 2 + 2 = 7 vehicles

messages_sl: Množična nesreča na primorski avtocesti pri Vrhniki: trije rdeči, štirje rumeni, pet zelenih.
Prvi na kraju: avtobus se je prevrnil, okoli dvanajst ponesrečencev, potrebujemo dodatna vozila.
basis: MCI guideline 2013: first team reports in METHANE format; dispatcher checklist; 25-vehicle surge at the UKC station

expected_replan: Helicopter drop-offs switch to the substitute site; an ambulance leg to UKC is added
Total time to UKC rises; planner compares with road-only
messages_sl: Heliport UKC je izpadel zaradi okvare gasilnega sistema, pristajamo v vojašnici Edvarda Peperka.
basis: UKC annual report 2025: temporary helipad outages, substitute site set up with the Ministry of Defence each time

events.name_en: Radio network down, phone app as backup
events.name_sl: Radijska zveza ne deluje, rezervni sistem
expected_replan: Vehicle positions become stale; planner widens ETA uncertainty
Engine data-source health goes to stale, the demo already shows this
messages_sl: Radijska zveza ne deluje, prehajamo na aplikacijo Intervencije.net.
basis: dispatch-service plan 2022: radio network coverage problems; phone app as backup
degraded update interval is an ASSUMPTION

events.name_en: Crew shortage: two crews off sick
expected_replan: A04 and A09 leave the pool; trips planned for them move
Reserve vehicle becomes usable only after the lead time
messages_sl: Reševalca na A04 sta zbolela, vozilo ne more na teren.
Dve ekipi manjkata, kličemo rezervne iz doma.
basis: UKC annual reports: staff shortage; dispatch plan: reserve-vehicle quota
lead time is an ASSUMPTION

proposed_payload.authority: dispatcher checks availability; minister's decision in a declared disaster

expected_replan: Scheduled trips move to the added vehicles after their lead time
Emergency ambulances are freed for stretcher and red cases
messages_sl: Zasebni prevozniki so na voljo: štiri sanitetna vozila v 30 minutah.
basis: MCI guideline checklist: ask private ambulance services about availability
count and lead time are ASSUMPTIONS

expected_replan: Pool grows in steps (own, reserve, private, Red Cross) with lead times
Scheduled trips are suspended; evacuation of immobile people uses non-urgent providers via dispatch
messages_sl: Potres jakosti sedem po evropski lestvici, državni načrt je aktiviran, minister je aktiviral načrt ministrstva za zdravje.
basis: Ministry of Health plan 2025: tiers by intensity; minister activates by order after national plan

expected_replan: Choose helicopter (about 31 min flight plus loading) if daylight and no fog, else ambulance (about 80 to 95 min, estimate)
Deadline from cross-clamp plus cold-ischaemia limit; pre-clear the UKC helipad crew
Other work is shed first if both options are tight
messages_sl: Srce za presaditev v UKC Maribor je pripravljeno, prevzem ob 10.30.
basis: Slovenija-transplant: central coordinators 24/7; Falcon used for long legs
limits from general medical sources
